headline: PINBALL gets a KICKBACK — one free save per ball at the drain
lede: The right side of CABINET ONE had no rescue device. Now a chrome button in a rubber ring pulses at the right drain column: slip a ball down fast and it fires back into play for +100 — once per ball, exactly like the free kickback on Williams cabinets of the early '80s. EMBER RIDER mirrors it, priced hotter at its own table's law.

notes.text: KICKBACK (#3250): ball-save zone as pure TABLE data — physics untouched, one save latches per ball and re-arms with the next. Centre drains stay deadly; resting balls never launch.

Harness grew honest: pinballcheck 147/147 with 8 new rule pins (fire price literals, re-arm, mirror zone W-x, minVy gate), pinballplay 30/30 live Chrome incl. pixel proofs of the armed pulse and plunger pop, and a 5th mutant (seized plunger) that dies on cue.

Warden target #3246 went to slot a at the claim; the PINBALL corpse from a dead slot-b session (#3232) shipped mid-verification by slot a, so the ladder rerouted live: idle-kick picked PINBALL again (score 7) and this stage took the next unowned honest gap.
mutateguard earned its keep again: refused a mutant run on a dirty tree (honest 0/5 first, then 5/5 clean after the commit).
